{{Quote|Amusing - Imperial vessels licking their wounds. I wonder how that fits into the Emperor's grand vision.''"<br />"''There's the code phrase. Switch your transponders and fall in with Zann's forces.|Tyber Zann and the ''Tartan'' cruisers' [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] a '''unit''' of four [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Tartan-class patrol cruiser|''Tartan'' patrol cruisers]] were tasked in defending a damaged [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] that had survived the battle. When [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyber Zann]] entered [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]] space in search of [[Data pod]]s left behind in the wreckage of the Death Star, these ''Tartan'' patrol cruisers betrayed the ''Acclamator'' they were protecting and defected to the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. They then assisted Tyber in retrieving the Data pods, before an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] arrived and the unit of ''Tartan'' cruisers retreated with Tyber's fleet to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|The Maw]].
